target_moa.text: Oral GnRH antagonist that competitively blocks GnRH receptors in the anterior pituitary, preventing LH and FSH release and thereby suppressing testosterone production; androgens such as testosterone stimulate prostate cancer growth.

citations.quote: Relugolix is an oral small molecule gonadotropin-releasing hormone (GnRH) antagonist. GnRH antagonists cause gonadotropin suppression by competitively blocking GnRH receptors in the anterior pituitary gland, which prevents endogenous GnRH from inducing LH and FSH release from pituitary cells.
Androgens such as testosterone have been shown to stimulate prostate cancer growth.
